releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 release package with the #350 startup ownership setup update. Start-ShareSurfer and Start-ShareSurferStartup can now help first-run operators when ownership inputs are missing: interactive startup can launch the multi-CSV ownership import picker to build ownership-enrichment.csv plus ownership context graph files, save reusable ownership import JSON/script outputs, return to the normal startup flow, and queue post-scan owner-mapping-draft.csv creation when owner-mapping.csv is not available yet. The release also carries the recent ownership import/context graph hardening and PASS4 scan/mapping behavior from #346 and #348. The package includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
